subject.title: Discord routing: mention > reply-target > default owner (suppress default owner when targeted)

question: Should Discord multi-bot routing suppress the per-channel default owner whenever an explicit bot mention or reply-target signal points at another configured bot?
rationale: The source gap is concrete, but default-owner suppression intentionally changes who receives existing stable Discord channel traffic when a targeted signal is present.

options.title: Adopt targeted precedence
options.body: Implement mention > reply-target > default-owner selection in the Discord plugin and prove default-owner suppression in targeted cases.

options.title: Require explicit policy
options.body: Preserve current default-owner behavior unless users enable a documented Discord multi-bot suppression setting.

options.title: Resolve narrower reply policy first
options.body: Review the open implicit-reply policy PR before deciding whether the broader cross-bot precedence contract should change.

recommendation.title: Adopt targeted precedence
recommendation.body: Implement mention > reply-target > default-owner selection in the Discord plugin and prove default-owner suppression in targeted cases.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest current-history signal across Discord preflight, shared mention policy, and routing decisions.
